Third-party Monaco syntax themes
===============================

This directory contains GitHub Dark.json and GitHub Light.json from
https://github.com/brijeshb42/monaco-themes/tree/master/themes
(commit source: master, retrieved 2026-07-30).

Copyright (c) Brijesh Bittu
License: MIT; see LICENSE.

XKeen uses the upstream token `rules` from these files through
`vendor/monaco_github_themes.js`. Editor and widget chrome remains controlled by
the XKeen Operator Console theme tokens at runtime.
